qualification: Conditional realization within the existing bed, not native chemical stock, new deposition, or an identified Earth formation. No line tint or geometric widening.

latitude_proxy.conditions: a=max(0,1-abs(abs(latitude)-30)/30). NOAA supports dry descending air near30 and wet ascending belts, NOT this function or hematite relation. Use only recorded deposition-step latitude. Not P/PET.

hematite.conditions: For already eligible unbleached dry-belt fluvial sandstone: w=0.002+0.005*a. UGS reports mean iron oxide0.007 red and0.002 white Navajo samples; interpreting iron as coating hematite and interpolating by latitude are project assumptions, not measured correlations. Humid uncoated band stays its prior; humidity does not prove bleaching.

thickness_m.interval_kind: reported analogue range, not all-fluvial uncertainty
thickness_m.conditions: Hawkesbury bottomset mud drapes1-3mm; extending to tops of intact modeled fluvial contribution sets is a conditional prior. Miall supports draped Kayenta internal erosion surfaces qualitatively. Not every natural surface carries a continuous drape.

clay_mass_fraction.conditions: Illite stands for inherited clay; quantitative enrichment and clay mineralogy are unmeasured project priors. Segregation removes this clay from the remaining host, conserving the chosen whole-bed mode.

grain_diameter_m.conditions: Representative optical aggregate diameter of silty/clayey drape, not individual clay platelet size or measured distribution. Grain sorting remains unknown.

thickness_m.conditions: Fine wind-ripple/grainfall lamina end member; bounding surfaces alone are zero-thickness erosion surfaces. No mud/clay enrichment without wet-interdune evidence; no native C7 eolian code exists, so producer never selects this branch.

grain_diameter_m.conditions: Finer dry sand lamina; no claim of measured particle distribution.

retention: Top drape lies inside original deposit; erosion removes top first, including drape. Retained drape thickness=max(0,min(original_h,prior_h)-(original_h-retained_h)); availability of every constituent imposes an additional finite-volume limit. Equal inherited porosity in host and drape; densities from mineral specific volumes; no stock admission.
